description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%9F%AC%EB%B8%8C%EC%83%B7/2759), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/61933251)  
「Did the arrow of love fly in the wrong direction?!」 Han Tae-hee, who just wanted to have a normal relationship where she could eat and laugh with the person she likes, was suddenly faced with an ordeal of love one day!  Because of Cupid's selfish ambition, he became a bitch in the world straddling both legs.  Due to an arrow shot by the mischievous Cupid, Han Tae-hee, who is in conflict between her antagonist 'Cha Jeong-woo', whom she must love, and her male friend 'Lee Do-young', whom she wanted to date, escapes Cupid's scheme and is happy with the person she truly likes. Can we reach the ending?
